author: IGN
description:
Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era reviewed on PC in Early Access by Jarrett Green.

Even though it's not a remake, Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is a great example of a game that follows the rules good remakes always should. It’s how I remember Heroes of Might and Magic 2 and 3, even if it doesn’t try to recreate those games frame-by-frame with new graphics. The simple combat is the star of the show, as it was in games past, still hiding depth and mastery that makes the difference between good and great play. Its fresh take on older factions and entirely new additions are vibrant and fun in combat where it matters most, but could stand to find more mechanical identity in their city management and hero selections. And although some of the randomness that is signature to the series has been corralled, it still can serve to make otherwise interesting systems frustrating to interact with in a meaningful way. But the core of Olden Era is as solid as the series has ever been, and
title: Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era Early Access Review

author: IGN
description:
Prophet is the first major hurdle in Saros, and this plant-like monstrosity is a brutal introduction to the game's "bullet ballet" combat. With three distinct health bars and a screen full of corrupted projectiles, defeating this beast requires a perfect blend of aggression and defensive timing. In this guide, we’ll walk you through every phase of the encounter, from destroying the side-orbs to exposing Prophet's glowing weak point, and how to navigate the arena's treacherous red grass.

Success against Prophet depends heavily on mastering your Soltari shield to absorb homing projectiles and knowing exactly when to dash through those expanding yellow ripples. We break down the boss's evolving stomp patterns and provide tips on managing the vine walls in the high-stakes final phase. Stick around after the breakdown for a full, unedited look at the Prophet boss fight in action to see these strategies put to the test on the planet Carcosa.

author: IGN
description:
Conquering the hostile moon of Carcosa requires more than just expert dodging; you need a perfectly tuned Armor Matrix to survive. In this guide, we break down how to effectively spend your Lucenite and Halcyon to turn Arjun into a powerhouse. From prioritizing Drive nodes in the early game to boost your currency gains to unlocking the game-changing Proficiency Enhancements, we’ll show you exactly how the skill tree functions and which paths lead to the most powerful upgrades.

Progression in Saros is gated by formidable bosses and rare resources. We explain the differences between Resilience, Command, and Drive nodes, and why you should never pass up a chance to grab Halcyon for those high-tier purple upgrades. Learn how to navigate the branching paths, manage your resources between runs, and optimize your build to handle the escalating difficulty of Housemarque's latest roguelite adventure.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Saros: The BEST Skills to Get First!

description:
Saros doesn't waste any time throwing you into the deep end. Immediately following the tutorial, players are pitted against Consort—a "supposed to lose" encounter designed to kickstart the game's narrative. But while the odds are stacked against you with base-level gear and a tiny health pool, victory is actually possible. We’re breaking down the exact strategy you need to survive Consort’s deadly beam attacks and showing you exactly what secret rewards await those skilled enough to win the fight.

This Saros gameplay guide covers the best tactics for defeating the tutorial boss, Consort, using the Level 1 Eruptor Handcannon. We go over how to dodge the red grid attacks, how to manage your shield against blue projectiles, and the timing required to survive the yellow beam explosions. If you manage to deplete the boss's health bar, you'll earn bonus Lucenite and a rare Halcyon for your Armor Matrix gear upgrades. This walkthrough ensures you know every phase of the fight and the specif
title: Saros: How to Beat the Tutorial Boss (and What Happens if You Win)

description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The Steam Machine is presumably just around the corner, and the Steam Controller is out, but what about the Steam Deck 2? IGN spoke with Valve about their upcoming hardware projects, and they gave us a small, but meaningful update on the successor to the succesful Steam Deck. In other news, Tom Taylorsen, who voiced Ryder in Mass Effect Andromeda, blames EA for the game's chilly reception. Andromeda was released in somewhat of an unfinished state, with a plethora of bugs, and fans of the series were not kind to the game at launch. And finally, we take a look at the mechanics you can expect in Housemarque’s latest title - SAROS.

Presented by SAROS. Rated T for Teen #ad
